Patch Notes - May 14, 2026

📜 Patch Notes - May 14, 2026

  • The Pawesome Festival is now active and will run for the next 2 weeks!
  • 10x recipes for Combat Manuals & Grimoires have been added

== 📜 Patch Notes - May 14, 2026 ==

* The [https://wiki.aa-classic.com/Pawsome_Festival Pawesome Festival] is now active and will run for the next 2 weeks!
* 10x recipes for Combat Manuals & Grimoires have been added
* The War Drum buff will now persist through death
